[[File:Hedgehog terangreal.png|alt=Carved wooden hedgehog about size of thumb on a wooden tabletop|border|right|320x320px]]
The '''hedgehog''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that was stolen from the [[White Tower]] by [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters]].
==Appearance==
The ''ter'angreal'' is a wooden carving in the shape of a hedgehog, no bigger than the last knuckle of a man's thumb.{{Ref/book|3|25}}

==Use==
Any woman who tried to channel through it went into half a day of peaceful dreamless sleep,{{ref/book|3|25}} and it could be used to trap others as well. However, there was apparently another, much more dangerous, use of it. 

It was left by the [[Black Ajah]] who fled the [[White Tower]] as a trap for [[Moiraine Sedai]] in [[Tear]].{{ref/book|3|53}} [[Faile]], who had instead triggered the trap, was captured in [[Tel'aran'rhiod]] and her body in the Waking World remained almost lifeless. The hedgehog was broken in Tel'aran'rhiod (in the wolf dream) by [[Perrin Aybara]] to rescue her.{{ref/book|3|55}}
